theorem GPointwiseConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM_kernel.{u_1} : ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K]
  [inst_1 : NumberField K] [inst_2 : MeasurableMul₂ (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)]
  [inst_3 : MeasurableInv (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K))
  [inst_4 : mu.IsMulLeftInvariant] [inst_5 : SigmaFinite mu] [inst_6 : IsLocallyFiniteMeasure mu] [mu.IsInvInvariant]
  (l r s : ℝ) (hlr : l ≤ r) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (h : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hh : Continuous h)
  (hc : HasCompactSupport h) (F : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
  (↑↑((PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs h hh hc) F) =ᶠ[ae mu] fun x =>
      ↑(PIntervalConvolution.intervalHalfWeight l r s (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x)) *
        ∫ (y : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
          h (x * y⁻¹) *
            (↑↑F y / ↑(PIntervalConvolution.intervalHalfWeight l r s (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K y))) ∂mu) ∧
    ∀ᵐ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K) ∂mu,
      Integrable
        (fun y =>
          h (x * y⁻¹) *
            (↑↑F y / ↑(PIntervalConvolution.intervalHalfWeight l r s (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K y))))
        mu :=

theorem DAllSourceKernel.both_tests_original_residual_kernel.{u_1} : ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K]
  [inst_1 : NumberField K] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)]
  [inst_3 : MeasurableMul₂ (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] [inst_4 : MeasurableInv (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)]
  (addHaar : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)) (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K))
  [inst_5 : mu.IsMulLeftInvariant] [inst_6 : SigmaFinite mu] [inst_7 : IsLocallyFiniteMeasure mu] [mu.IsInvInvariant]
  (a l r s : ℝ) (hlr : l ≤ r) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (phi : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hh : Continuous phi)
  (hc : HasCompactSupport phi),
  (∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x = 0 → phi x = 0) →
    ∀ (q : Fin 2) (F : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
      let h := LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q;
      have tests := ⋯;
      have A := PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs h ⋯ ⋯;
      have b := fun x => PIntervalConvolution.intervalHalfWeight l r s (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x);
      let E :=
        DSourceKernel.sourceSpan mu 0 0
          (OAllCharacterClosure.fullSourceMap K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s);
      have P := (JThetaAttachment.fullThetaClosure K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s)ᗮ.starProjection;
      have k := fun T => DSourceKernel.residualKernel mu b (E T) A fun x y => h (x * y⁻¹);
      have kF := fun T x => ↑(b x) * ∫ (y : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), k T x y * (↑↑F y / ↑(b y)) ∂mu;
      (∀ (T : Finset ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)), (fun x => ↑↑(A F - (E T).starProjection (A F)) x) =ᶠ[ae mu] kF T) ∧
        (∀ (T : Finset ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
            (∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), k T x x = -DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b (E T) A x x) ∧
              Integrable (fun x => k T x x) mu ∧
                ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), k T x x ∂mu =
                    -Masullo.TraceClass.trace ((E T).starProjection.comp A) ∧
                  Tendsto
                    (fun n =>
                      ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
                        (DReview.physicalBand K n).indicator (fun x => k T x x) x ∂mu)
                    atTop (nhds (-Masullo.TraceClass.trace ((E T).starProjection.comp A)))) ∧
          ∃ (hm : ∀ (T : Finset ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)), MemLp (kF T) 2 mu),
            (∀ (T : Finset ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)), MemLp.toLp (kF T) ⋯ = A F - (E T).starProjection (A F)) ∧
              Tendsto (fun T => MemLp.toLp (kF T) ⋯) atTop (nhds ((P.comp A) F)) :=
⋯
